title: DJMAX RESPECT V
provenance: Reported by paripob (highball-db#165, 2026-09-21): rated 4, playable with minor issues, Apple M4 Pro, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, Highball 0.9.32, 10 minutes played through Highball; the environment ran DXMT with msync and the steam recipe (from the report's settings field). The minor issues were not described. Not run here. The same reporter on DXVK (highball-db#171, 2026-09-21): rated 5, 2 minutes, 'input delay, but literally everything else worked fine and worked way better than on dxmt'.
notes: A rhythm game, so timing is the thing to watch. The reporter tried both modes on an M4 Pro with macOS 27 and found DXVK much better than DXMT, with input delay as the remaining complaint; DXMT was rated playable with unspecified minor issues after ten minutes. Use DXVK. No frame rate recorded, and nobody has measured the actual input latency.

knownIssues.symptom: Input delay, noticeable in a rhythm game
knownIssues.cause: reported on both graphics modes, worse on DXMT; not measured here
knownIssues.fix: Use DXVK, which the reporter found much better. No fix for the remaining delay yet.
